# ADR-0016: API contract: OpenAPI generated by core, typed client in web

- Status: Accepted
- Date: 2026-10-08
- Deciders: Javi
- Related requirements: NFR-12, NFR-13

## Context

Web and core must stay in sync without manual DTO copying.

## Options considered

| Option | Pros | Cons |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Code-first OpenAPI via springdoc, committed to packages/api-contract | Contract always matches the code; TS types generated | Generated file must be refreshed |
| Contract-first YAML | Design before code | Two sources of truth while iterating |

## Decision

springdoc generates the OpenAPI document from `apps/core`; it is committed to `packages/api-contract/openapi.yaml`. `openapi-typescript` generates types and web uses a typed fetch client. CI regenerates the document and fails if it differs from the committed one.

## Consequences

Breaking API changes are visible in the PR diff of `openapi.yaml`.
